selected_passages.text: In the US v. Google antitrust trial, Eddy Cue, Apple's Senior Vice President of Internet Software & Services, testified about the Information Services Agreement (ISA) with Google, which makes Google the default search engine on Apple devices. The deal has been in place since 2002, and Apple negotiated a higher revenue share with Google in 2016. During his testimony, Cue emphasized that Apple believed in Google's product quality and prioritized user privacy, stating there was no viable alternative to Google at the time.
